assessments.reasoning: The target definition unions terms produced by the individual target declarations. The normative textual node-target rule produces the named IRI or literal singleton for any data graph.

challenge.method: Check two declarations with an overlapping focus term and a node target absent from the data graph. Contrast a focus node supplied directly or found by a shape-expecting constraint with ordinary declared target computation.
challenge.results: The overlapping term occurs once in the declared target set. A well-formed node target contributes its specified term even when absent from the graph. Direct or nested focus selection may ignore declared targets and is outside the claim.

limitations: The claim covers the Core declared target calculation for a well-formed shape and the stated node-target rule. It does not restrict independently supplied focus nodes or extension-specific targets.
